# Cycling of sulfonated cellulose nanofiber separators in zinc–iodine flow cells (unpublished results)

## Context
Following our published sulfonated cellulose nanofiber (CNF) membrane, we extended cycling tests to evaluate long-term stability.

## Results
- The sulfonated CNF membrane completed 500 hours of cycling at 20 mA cm-2 with a coulombic efficiency above 98 %.
- Iodide crossover remained below the detection limit of UV-vis spectroscopy after 300 hours.
- Membrane swelling in the electrolyte stabilised at 18 % after the first 24 hours.

<!-- page -->

## Open questions
- Does the membrane remain stable beyond 1,000 hours?
- Can the sulfonation degree be reduced without increasing crossover?

## Data available
Cycling curves, impedance spectra at 0, 100, 300 and 500 hours, and SEM images of the membrane surface after cycling.
